description: Composite BUY / SELL / HOLD trade verdict for a perpetual-futures market, with a 0–100 confidence score, the current market regime, live price, and multi-factor reasoning (funding rate, open-interest change, 24h volume, trend persistence, breakout state) across 17 derivatives venues. Verdict accuracy is independently auditable via a Merkle-anchored track record on Base. When the queried market is a HOLD, returns the nearest higher-confidence setups so an agent can route to an actionable market.
